notes: Fixed folder file-counting accuracy on NAS/network shares and reparse points
changelog: Fixed: counting files from a folder on network storage (NAS/QNAP) or containing reparse points could silently undercount by a large margin, or in rare cases hang or crash — an internal file-listing step tried to fully "open" certain entries, and a single unusual file could abort counting for that entire subfolder. File listing now uses the same low-level Windows API as tools like Everything/TreeSize, reading directory entries directly without opening them — verified to match an independent reference count exactly on a real 700,000+ file NAS share
Added: a Stop button while counting files from a folder, so a very large or slow scan can be cancelled
Added: elapsed time shown next to the live file counter
Added: protection against circular folder links (symbolic links/junctions pointing back to an ancestor folder), which could previously cause a crash
